biological_replicate: YM97 and YM6 wheat seed samples
Wheat tissue samples with germination rates of 97% and 6% (named YM97 and YM6, respectively) were collected for the quantitative proteomic analysis of acetylation modifications.
experimental_design: A total of 175 differentially acetylated proteins, including 84 up-regulated and 91 down-regulated acetylated proteins, were characterized in the YM6 versus YM97 comparison.
factor_value: Wheat tissue samples with germination rates of 97% and 6% (named YM97 and YM6, respectively) were collected for the quantitative proteomic analysis of acetylation modifications.
number_of_fractions: Briefly, the peptides were separated into 60 fractions, combined into four fractions and dried using vacuum centrifugation.
